category.title: iPhone 13
category.description: Apple's mainstream 2021 iPhone was released on September 24th and comes with a 6.1" OLED display, a dual 12 MP camera system, and in five available colors. Successor to the iPhone 12.
category.contents_raw:
== Identification ==
You can identify the iPhone 13 by finding one of the model numbers either on the inner edge of the SIM card tray or within the phone's Settings app:

* ***A2482***
* ***A2631***
* ***A2633***
* ***A2634***
* ***A2635***
